title: test(rest, dogfood): pin the action list agreeing with the by-name read beside a package-less action on another object
body:

_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbBePzY6g11h3hyWk5ud4vWy)_
Part of #33904 — this PR lands the card's measurement and its pins: the HTTP reach of item 1 (not reached; the card regrades to p3) and item 2 (closed on main by #33898, pinned here). The listing seam itself (`readFlattenedMetaItems`) is not changed and stays on the card at p3.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:只加测试,不改产品代码。一是真实启动的 showcase 上,经 HTTP 钉住"动作列表与按名读取答同一项"(包先存、环境先存两种顺序);二是钉住"停用包在另一个对象上持有同名动作时,环境自己的动作按名读取照常返回、不挂停用包的包名"(#33898 已在 main 修好)。
- 为什么改:卡 #33904 要求先测 HTTP 能否遇到"列表漏掉环境自建动作"。实测 HTTP 走不到这个形状:托管包的同名动作在另一个对象上保存会被 403 拒绝;可写包则保存后只剩一条,列表和按名读取一致。所以按卡的规则降为 p3 并补钉子。
- 风险与回滚:零产品风险,只多两个测试用例块和一个 dogfood 测试文件;回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/qa/dogfood/test/action-list-packageless-other-object.dogfood.test.ts`(HTTP 一致性钉子);`packages/rest/src/meta-qualified-item-route.test.ts` 中 `[#33904] a disabled holder on another object`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/meta-qualified-item-route.test.ts -t 33904`,预期 2 个用例通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

Tests only; no product file moves.

1. **Item 1, HTTP reach (measured first, as the card asks).** On a real showcase boot (`bootShowcase`, admin session), the card's shape (a package's action on one object and the environment's package-less row of the same name on another, both stored) is not reached over HTTP:
   - managed code package (`showcase_open_docs` on `showcase_task`): `PUT /api/v1/meta/action/showcase_open_docs` with `objectName: showcase_product` and no `?package=` answers `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE`; the list and the by-name read keep answering the package's item;
   - Studio-created writable package, both save orders: each save answers 200, and the store ends with ONE item of the name. The list, `?names=`, `?package=` and the by-name reads all answer that one item.

   So the listing and the by-name read agree on every HTTP-reachable state measured, and the card regrades to p3 (its rule 3). `action-list-packageless-other-object.dogfood.test.ts` pins that agreement in both orders.
2. **Item 2 (the seat's addition).** A package-less action on `contact` beside a DISABLED holder of the name on `account`: the #33385 fold's harness probe reported the by-name read stamping the disabled holder's `_packageId`, so the face withheld the item (404). Re-run on main with #33898 (`68e726d631`): served (200), `objectName: contact`, no `_packageId`, no package provenance, in both registration orders, for the environment's own item and for a registry-only package-less item. Pinned as a nested describe in the #33456 block of the REST harness, and ablated (below). The reading is also on the card.

No answer moves, so there is no FROM→TO table.

## Tests

- `packages/rest/src/meta-qualified-item-route.test.ts`, describe `[#33904] a disabled holder on another object` (2 cases × 2 registration orders; real `SchemaRegistry`, real protocol, real `RestServer` route table).
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/action-list-packageless-other-object.dogfood.test.ts` (new, isolated project; 2 cases, one per save order).

## Acceptance notes

- Not changed here, carried on the card at p3: below HTTP the merged list slots an action by name alone (`mergePackageAwareOverlay`), and the sealed-managed decline (`declinesStoredRow`, `isStoredEntryOfDeclinedName`) judges an action by name, not by `(object, name)`. A package-less row stored beside a package's action on another object (the boot harness shape) is therefore left out of the list while the bare by-name read serves it. No HTTP save reaches that state today (above). NOT MEASURED: an environment row authored BEFORE a managed package that ships the same name on another object is installed.
- Reported to the seat, not fixed here: with a writable package holding `qa_x` on `showcase_task`, a package-less `PUT /meta/action/qa_x` on `showcase_product` answers 200 and the package's own address then serves the product body (the package's action moved object); in the other order the package's save takes the environment's item over. Both read against ADR-0150 D4's `(package, object, name)` key; the save door is outside this PR's surface.
